summary: Paper and README now state, in plain language, why the method pays off (cheaper than agents looping locally, works alone and makes agents' work visible to a team, documents itself, faster onboarding of new agents) and what is core, replaceable or optional. RQ5 and an onboarding metric added; stale knowledge added as a limitation; the conclusion separates design from validation. Figure 6 updated; PDF rebuilt.
